posts.title: BIP-110 monitoring stream: mandatory signaling start
posts.description: On August 8th, 2026, Bitcoin block 961632 was mined. This marked the start of the “mandatory signaling” for BIP-110 , which meant all blocks not signaling on version bit 4 would be rejected by a node implementing BIP-110. posts.title: Matching Hashes: Reproducing the Guix-built Bitcoin Core release binary with Nix
posts.description: Earlier this week, I produced a Nix-built bitcoind binary for Bitcoin Core v31.0 whose hash exactly matches the official Guix-built x86_64-pc-linux-gnu release binary. The result came out of a three year old side project, with a difficult goal: Can a binary built with Nix be made bit-for-bit identical to one produced by Bitcoin Core’s Guix reproducible build system?
